state:
**Goal `tooling-overhaul`, Stage 10.** The cutover is on `main`. `main` stays frozen, and tag `pre-overhaul` is the rollback.

`bun nv playbook --triage <section>` is on disk (`tools/nv/cmd/playbook.ts:707`). Sections `divergences`, `splitting-a-file` and `running-things` are decided. `writing-a-test-case` has 160 of 536 bullets left to decide: its alphabetical first 280 (up to `a-tds-parameter-that-starts-0xff-…`) are decided. `writing-novis` and `tooling` (301 of 397) still owe too.

A bullet has two homes that are read: the fragment under `docs/agent/playbook/<section>/` and the record under `data/playbook/<section>/`. A batch changes both. `.agent-tmp/triage-splitting.ts <batch.json>` is the batch script. Its batch file is `{ "section", "delete": [ids], "keep": { id: "path:word" } }`, and `.agent-tmp/triage-test-8.json` is the latest example. The script checks that each `gone` condition stands before it writes anything, and refuses the whole batch if one does not. It also deletes a bullet an earlier batch kept, which is how a later, clearer duplicate replaces it. A `gone` word must not contain `]`, because the trailer parser stops at the first one. The report's `propose` word is often a poor anchor (a binary, a generic word): check it with `git grep -n -F`. A diagnostic's code (`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:E0459`) is a good anchor for a language claim.

The report's `OWES A DECISION` / `DECIDED` flag is on the `==` header line. `awk '/^== /{p = /OWES A DECISION/} p'` pulls only the owed blocks, and `awk '/^== /{n++} n<=35'` over that takes one batch; `grep -v '^  means'` drops the noise lines.

A language claim is cheap to probe: a short `.nvs` under `.agent-tmp/p/` run with `target/debug/nvs.exe run` (top-level code declares with a type or `var`; a helper is a `public static function` in a class; a constructor is `constructor`). Probes this session found these compile now: a negative `decimal` literal, a class passed to a shape parameter, a `!= null` guard feeding an argument or a `string` return, `mixed as Core\Uri`, and a `Core` enum helper parameter. These are still refused: `?uint ?? 0` into `uint`, `int + uint` (`E0407`), a second `foreach` binding of the same name even at the same type (`E0406`), a non-constant property default (`E0472`), `&&`-joined null tests, narrowing inside a loop body, and `decimal` beside a float literal or ternary. `docs/agent/loop-goal.toml` is gone, so a bullet naming it is kept only when its lesson is about the tree.

The goal-only sweep is red on the four checks later stages own: Stage 9's `audit checks`, Stage 11's `audit ci` and `loop-stats --guard`, and Stage 12's `audit python`, plus Stage 10's trailer check until every section is triaged.
